title: 4BR Vacation Home in Blue Mountain Beach with a Private Pool
meta_description: Stay at Petit Bonheur, a 4BR, 3BA vacation home in Blue Mountain Beach, FL, with a private pool, a spacious kitchen, and a wraparound balcony. Sleeps 12.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Petit Bonheur
normalized_matching_profile.description: Petit Bonheur is a hidden gem in Blue Mountain Beach, just a 3-minute walk to the shore and only six homes from the beach. With a lush backyard and private pool, this modern 4-bedroom retreat comfortably hosts up to 12 guests.The spacious kitchen is equipped for group meals and gatherings, flanked by two dining areas: an open dining room and a bright breakfast nook. The layout flows seamlessly into the large living area, perfect for relaxing after a day out. One bedroom is conveniently located on the first floor, while three more await upstairs. The generously sized master suite offers direct access to the Crow’s Nest—an upper-level wraparound balcony where you can enjoy Gulf views, whether indoors in the comfort of air conditioning or out on the deck during sunset.Families with little ones will appreciate the thoughtful amenities, including a high chair, pack and play, baby gate, and a hook-on baby chair for the table. A dedicated workspace is also available, ideal for those mixing business with leisure.The fenced-in backyard feels like a private tropical retreat, complete with a shaded grilling area, plenty of seating, and a refreshing private pool—perfect for laid-back afternoons. Guests can easily access snacks and drinks with the kitchen just steps away. To enhance your beach days, beach chairs, umbrellas, and boogie boards are provided.High-speed connectivity is available throughout the home with 2GB internet, supporting everything from remote work to streaming and video calls. As a bonus, guests at Petit Bonheur will receive exclusive lanyards for access to the Blue Mountain Beach Access.With a touch of Old Florida charm and the comforts of modern design, Petit Bonheur is a memorable 30A vacation destination.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV.1st Floor, Living Room: Sofa pulls out to a queen bed.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, TV, seating area plus entry to Crow's Nest2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds, TV.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: Queen bed, TV.Beach Access:The Blue Mountain Beach access requires a QR scan to enter -- be sure to bring one of the two lanyards provided to gain access to this beach. Head south down Sand Dunes Road until you reach Blue Mountain Road. Here you'll head west until you reach your beach access, Blue Mountain Beach.Distance: .2 miles | Time: 4 minutes walkingBlue Mountain Beach:The Blue Mountain Beach neighborhood has something for everyone. The local creamery has made its mark on this delightful neighborhood - when you come to Blue Mountain, you have to stop for their homemade ice cream. Just a short drive west and you’re close to all the shopping, restaurants, and entertainment of Sandestin, Miramar Beach and Destin. Go east and you can visit all the popular South Walton beach communities of Grayton Beach, Seagrove, Seaside and more.Your stay at Petit Bonheur comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee.* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 4 cars.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
